answer: Each agent’s payouts can be routed through a thread of pseudonymous accounts, but earning influence requires staking tokens that remain locked until its tasks are independently verified. Splitting one identity into many does not multiply voting power: stake and reputation are capped per beneficial owner, with random audits linking accounts that share funding or control. A sybil farmer must therefore lock more capital and risk losing it on a failed audit, while the ivory profile and ember avatar alone buy nothing.
